subject.title: Feature request: Add CarPlay support to the official iOS app

question: Should OpenClaw pursue official iOS CarPlay support now, and if so which Apple app category, entitlement path, and constrained Talk UX should the app target?
rationale: This is a new official app and release-signing surface, not a broken existing contract; automation cannot choose the Apple entitlement strategy, App Store posture, or vehicle-safe interaction model.

options.title: Scope CarPlay Talk Mode
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical CarPlay request and ask iOS owners to define the category, entitlement plan, and minimal Talk-only UX before implementation.

options.title: Fold Into Mobile Design RFC
options.body: Evaluate CarPlay inside the broader mobile design process before accepting a platform-specific implementation issue.

options.title: Decline For Now
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide CarPlay entitlement, review, or safety constraints make this out of scope for the official app in the near term.

recommendation.title: Scope CarPlay Talk Mode
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical CarPlay request and ask iOS owners to define the category, entitlement plan, and minimal Talk-only UX before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent iOS app metadata/signing and product-surface history makes this the best available owner for the entitlement and official-app direction decision.
